formulaBlock.normalization: No split entries; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based). Packet notes identical formula on a 300 ml pack (provenance only).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) defining anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3); no reinforcing strong anionic; Sodium Xylenesulfonate (4) is a hydrotrope.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: No refatting or conditioning counter-signal at all; an essentially pure cleansing base. Convention unchanged.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led; no cationic polymer, silicone, lipid, refatter or pearlizer; only a late Panthenol (13). Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose (11) is a nonionic thickener.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Panthenol and Histidine (16) are trace care additives.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: no deposition family at all; buffered SLES chassis.

depositionLoad.rationale: No silicone, polymer, lipid, refatter, protein or film former.

excluded.reason: nonionic cellulose thickener, no cationic charge

weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: No depositing system exists to make residue plausible.

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Care-direction verdict: nonspecific (no care architecture). A clean, low-weight base could be compatible with volume or clarifying-type positioning if claimed.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA formula half NOT met: no prominent E4 route (Panthenol 13 post-fragrance).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Sodium Salicylate (10) is a preservative.
